meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 群组搭建 Karpathy 式持久 wiki 知识库:建 wiki/、sources/ 目录和 index.md、log.md,生成维护规则并写进群组 CLAUDE.md;之后按规则逐条收录资料并更新页面。
howto.when: 当你说“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等词,或请它给 NanoClaw 群组加知识库时触发。

say.text: 帮这个群组建一个 wiki 知识库吧。
say.note: 它会先说明模式,再问群组和内容方向。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 收进 wiki,并更新相关页面。
say.note: 它会一次只处理这一份,完成后才继续。

say.text: 每月定时检查一次 wiki 的完整性。
say.note: 会用 schedule_task 安排 lint 任务。

howto.what_en: Adds a Karpathy LLM Wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/, index.md and log.md, a container skill, and a CLAUDE.md wiki section. Then ingests sources one by one and updates pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or asks to add a knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Set up a wiki knowledge base for this group.
say_en.note: It explains the pattern, then asks which group and topic.

say_en.text: Add this PDF to the wiki and update related pages.
say_en.note: It processes this file fully before moving on.

say_en.text: Schedule a monthly wiki health check.
say_en.note: It schedules the lint task with schedule_task.
